report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172 ms; traces show successful checkout spans with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. No fault is established by current evidence. The alert's latency figures are within normal range, so no bounded root cause can be substantiated; hand off for operator review.
